newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panamanian airline to issue $10 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Panamanian airline to issue $10 mln in bonds.

text.p: Panamanian airline Aerolineas del Pacifico (Aeroperlas) will make a $10 million bond issue on April 28, a stock exchange spokeswoman said Tuesday.
"Aeroperlas will be the first Panamanian company to make a micro title issue using the clearing system," she said.
The bond issue will be made through the Panamanian stock exchange's electronic clearing system called Central Latinoamericana de Valores (Latinclear). The name was recently changed from Panaclear.
The computerized system, set up last year with funding from the Inter-American Development Bank, makes transactions more accurate and safer, the spokeswoman said.
